comment: Allowed median growth per benchmark name pattern, over the default --threshold (first match wins). Measured on the bench agent over the five v0.4.0 baseline runs: the multi-threaded physics steps of 100 bodies vary up to 40 % (waking the workers), the physics world creation of 100 bodies up to 90 %, the MCP loopback round trips and the game-over scene load about 25 to 33 %.
